lines: | artifact_or_control_id | category | retention_tag | legal_hold_behavior | erasure_behavior | projection_allowed | replay_preservation_required | restore_reconciliation_required | source_ref |

| ActorSession | SESSION_CONTROL_OBJECT | policy_governed_other | Session audit lineage survives logout, compromise response, or administrator invalidation. | Session invalidation rotates or revokes challenge state and blocks replay of stale commands. | RUNTIME_AND_AUDIT_ONLY | no | no | Algorithm/security_and_runtime_hardening_contract.md::L36[ActorSession] |

| ApiCommandReceipt | READ_PROJECTION | derived_artifact | Receipts preserve command recovery anchors and session lineage during investigations or incident review. | Expired success projections keep the same recovery-anchor family instead of degrading into transport-only timeout markers. | OPERATOR_AND_RUNTIME_ONLY | no | no | Algorithm/northbound_api_and_session_contract.md::L48[ApiCommandReceipt] |

| ArtifactRetention | RETENTION_CONTROL_OBJECT | policy_governed_other | LEGAL_HOLD and ERASURE_PENDING states require concrete follow-up workflow refs and next checkpoints. | PSEUDONYMISED and ERASED states require durable request/action/proof linkage. | OPERATOR_AND_AUDIT_ONLY | no | yes | Algorithm/retention_and_privacy.md::L58[ArtifactRetention] |

| AuditEvent | AUDIT_AND_OBSERVABILITY | operational_log | Audit evidence remains durably queryable during legal hold and release transitions. | Payload bodies may expire, but object, reason, lineage, and audit-family minimums must survive. | OPERATOR_AND_AUDIT_ONLY | yes | yes | Algorithm/retention_limited_explainability_and_audit_sufficiency_contract.md::L61[AuditEvent] |

| AuthorityIngressReceipt | AUTHORITY_TRANSPORT | regulated_record | Authority ingress proof survives legal hold because it anchors request-lineage and duplicate suppression. | Ingress authentication and lineage proof may be minimized, but cannot be reconstructed from transient transport memory. | OPERATOR_AND_AUDIT_ONLY | yes | yes | Algorithm/security_and_runtime_hardening_contract.md::L113[AuthorityIngressReceipt] |

| AuthorityInteractionRecord | AUTHORITY_TRANSPORT | regulated_record | Authority-facing history ambiguity cannot be resolved by deletion and must remain explicit. | Deletion is blocked where it would obscure already observed authority history. | OPERATOR_AND_AUDIT_ONLY | yes | yes | Algorithm/retention_error_and_observability_contract.md::L35[AuthorityInteractionRecord] |

| CacheIsolationContract | CACHE_CONTROL_OBJECT | policy_governed_other | Hold does not widen cache reuse; the contract only controls lawful reuse and purge semantics. | Broader variants purge immediately on access or masking narrowing and must not silently survive. | OPERATOR_AND_RUNTIME_ONLY | no | no | Algorithm/cache_isolation_and_secure_reuse_contract.md::L16[CacheIsolationContract] |

| ClientPortalWorkspace | CACHE_AND_PROJECTION | analytics_projection | Portal reuse remains bound to customer-safe projection and visibility posture even under retention limitation. | Background refresh, stale tabs, or direct URLs cannot widen the reviewed slice once masking or route context drifts. | CUSTOMER_SAFE_ONLY | no | no | Algorithm/customer_client_portal_experience_contract.md::L753[ClientPortalWorkspace] |

| ClientUploadSession | UPLOAD_AND_COLLABORATION | derived_artifact | Follow-on hold or erasure decisions must preserve staged lineage and publish posture explicitly. | Staged bytes remain non-downloadable and cannot satisfy a rebased request silently. | LIMITED_EXPLICIT_ONLY | no | yes | Algorithm/northbound_api_and_session_contract.md::L59[ClientUploadSession] |

| CollaborationAttachment | UPLOAD_AND_COLLABORATION | regulated_record | Published attachment lineage and unavailable reasons remain visible during hold or quarantine review. | Quarantined or policy-limited files render as typed unavailable state rather than disappearing silently. | MASKED_OR_LIMITED_ONLY | no | yes | Algorithm/collaboration_workspace_contract.md::L851[CollaborationAttachment] |

| ConfigFreeze | AUTHORITATIVE_TRUTH | regulated_record | Legal hold blocks erasure when the config freeze remains necessary for proof preservation. | If direct payload retention narrows, explicit limitation placeholders must preserve the frozen execution basis. | OPERATOR_AND_AUDIT_ONLY | yes | yes | Algorithm/retention_and_privacy.md::L240[ConfigFreeze] |

| DecisionBundle | READ_PROJECTION | derived_artifact | Underlying legal hold preserves the truth basis that informs the bundle's visible limitation posture. | Visible confidence and explainability must degrade rather than overclaim when retained support narrows. | MASKED_OR_LIMITED_ONLY | no | yes | Algorithm/retention_and_privacy.md::L150[DecisionBundle] |

| EnquiryPack | EXPLAINABILITY_ARTIFACT | regulated_record | Legal hold and omission posture must travel with the export when relevant. | Exports must keep retention binding, omission entries, and limitation notes under retention pressure. | MASKED_OR_LIMITED_ONLY | yes | yes | Algorithm/retention_limited_explainability_and_audit_sufficiency_contract.md::L44[EnquiryPack] |

| ErasureProof | RETENTION_CONTROL_OBJECT | operational_log | Erasure proof must show when legal hold blocked or released the workflow. | Erasure can never destroy the append-only proof that request, decision basis, and execution outcome occurred. | OPERATOR_AND_AUDIT_ONLY | no | yes | Algorithm/retention_and_privacy.md::L175[ErasureProof] |

| EvidenceGraph | EXPLAINABILITY_ARTIFACT | derived_artifact | If legal hold blocks erasure, the graph must show the retained-limited posture rather than hiding it. | Expired or erased edges must remain explicit present-but-limited evidence, not broken graph absence. | LIMITED_EXPLICIT_ONLY | yes | yes | Algorithm/retention_limited_explainability_and_audit_sufficiency_contract.md::L40[EvidenceGraph] |

| GateDecisionRecordLineage | AUTHORITATIVE_TRUTH | regulated_record | Gate lineage remains on hold when needed to preserve decisive-path audibility. | Derived gate lineage may survive with explicit limitation notes even when underlying support narrows. | OPERATOR_AND_AUDIT_ONLY | yes | yes | Algorithm/retention_and_privacy.md::L248[gate_lineage] |

| HashSetExecutionBasis | AUTHORITATIVE_TRUTH | regulated_record | Any hold preserving replay basis must preserve execution-basis hash lineage. | Hashes survive payload minimization and may outlive direct content as the lawful replay placeholder. | OPERATOR_AND_AUDIT_ONLY | yes | yes | Algorithm/retention_and_privacy.md::L246[execution_basis_hash] |

| InputFreeze | AUTHORITATIVE_TRUTH | regulated_record | Legal hold preserves auditable input lineage while keeping any erasure blocker explicit. | Eligible content may be minimized or pseudonymised, but the engine must preserve hashes, lineage, and limitation notes. | LIMITED_EXPLICIT_ONLY | yes | yes | Algorithm/retention_and_privacy.md::L240[InputFreeze] |

| MaskedExportArtifact | EXPORT_AND_VIEW | derived_artifact | Export limitation posture stays explicit if hold or minimization narrows the delivered slice. | Exports inherit masking/export policy and may not bypass it through direct object-store URLs. | MASKED_ONLY | no | yes | Algorithm/retention_and_privacy.md::L208[MaskedExportArtifact] |

| NativeCacheHydrationContract | CACHE_CONTROL_OBJECT | policy_governed_other | Hold does not bypass first-paint legality or live rebase requirements. | Purges regulated local artifacts on tenant, session, masking, route, preview, or schema drift. | NATIVE_RESTORE_ONLY_WHEN_FULL_MATCH | no | no | Algorithm/native_cache_hydration_purge_and_rebase_contract.md::L14[NativeCacheHydrationContract] |

| NativeLocalArtifactSet | CACHE_AND_EXPORT | analytics_projection | Local derivatives purge with the same revocation and masking boundaries as structured cache. | NSUserActivity, preview caches, temporary exports, and search indices are purged or invalidated with cache state. | NATIVE_LOCAL_ONLY_WITH_FULL_BINDING | no | no | Algorithm/macos_native_operator_workspace_blueprint.md::L488[NativeLocalArtifactSet] |

| ProofBundle | EXPLAINABILITY_ARTIFACT | regulated_record | Hold may preserve proof-path support while keeping hold lineage explicit on the retained bundle. | A filing-capable bundle must downgrade when decisive support falls below τ_submit or any decisive limitation is silent. | LIMITED_EXPLICIT_ONLY | yes | yes | Algorithm/retention_and_privacy.md::L218[ProofBundle] |

| ReplayAttestation | AUTHORITATIVE_TRUTH | regulated_record | Replay attestation persists when required to prove historical comparison outcome. | If supporting payload narrows, replay must surface RETENTION_LIMITED explicitly instead of synthesizing a newer basis. | OPERATOR_AND_AUDIT_ONLY | yes | yes | Algorithm/retention_and_privacy.md::L250[ReplayAttestation] |

| RestorePrivacyReconciliationContract | RESTORE_CONTROL_OBJECT | policy_governed_other | Blocked legal hold, proof preservation, and authority ambiguity states remain explicit legal posture, not notes. | Restore-time resurrected erased data opens compensating re-erasure workflow before reopen. | RUNTIME_AND_AUDIT_ONLY | yes | yes | Algorithm/recovery_tier_checkpoint_and_fail_forward_governance_contract.md::L86[RestorePrivacyReconciliationContract] |

| RetentionTag | RETENTION_CONTROL_OBJECT | policy_governed_other | Canonical legal-hold state, hold ref, and change chronology live here. | Carries erasure_eligibility, erasure_reason_codes, limitation behavior, proof preservation basis, and authority ambiguity blockers. | OPERATOR_AND_AUDIT_ONLY | no | yes | Algorithm/retention_and_privacy.md::L13[RetentionTag] |

| RunManifest | AUTHORITATIVE_TRUTH | regulated_record | Legal hold may block erasure and must remain visibly queryable via the canonical retention tag. | Payload minimization may remove direct content, but manifest lineage and RETENTION_LIMITED placeholders must survive without rewriting basis hashes. | LIMITED_EXPLICIT_ONLY | yes | yes | Algorithm/retention_and_privacy.md::L240[RunManifest] |

| SecretVersion | SECRET_CONTROL_OBJECT | policy_governed_other | Secret rotation chronology remains auditable even across retirement or revocation. | Rotation fails closed if attestation or version binding is unknown; retired and revoked chronology remains serialized. | RUNTIME_AND_AUDIT_ONLY | no | yes | Algorithm/security_and_runtime_hardening_contract.md::L67[SecretVersion] |

| SubmissionRecord | AUTHORITY_TRANSPORT | regulated_record | Submission history remains preserved when required for legal-state audit and replay-safe recovery. | Restore or queue recovery cannot blindly replay mutations from transport artifacts alone. | OPERATOR_AND_AUDIT_ONLY | yes | yes | Algorithm/recovery_tier_checkpoint_and_fail_forward_governance_contract.md::L113[SubmissionRecord] |

| TelemetryLogTrace | AUDIT_AND_OBSERVABILITY | operational_log | Logs and traces preserve correlation lineage but remain subordinate to audit proof. | Diagnostic logging must not reintroduce personal or authority-secret data that policy would otherwise hide. | OPERATOR_ONLY_MINIMIZED | no | yes | Algorithm/retention_error_and_observability_contract.md::L141[TelemetryLogTrace] |

| UploadRequestBindingContract | UPLOAD_AND_COLLABORATION | policy_governed_other | Binding posture survives so upload rebase decisions remain auditable during legal or retention review. | Rebases and supersession surface as typed states rather than silent rebinding. | OPERATOR_AND_AUDIT_ONLY | no | yes | Algorithm/northbound_api_and_session_contract.md::L206[UploadRequestBindingContract] |

| WorkInboxSnapshot | CACHE_AND_PROJECTION | analytics_projection | Snapshot visibility remains subordinate to upstream truth and retention posture. | Caches rebuild from durable truth; broader variants purge immediately on visibility or masking narrowing. | MASKED_OR_LIMITED_ONLY | no | no | Algorithm/collaboration_workspace_contract.md::L2163[WorkInboxSnapshot] |

| WorkspaceSnapshot | CACHE_AND_PROJECTION | analytics_projection | Workspace reads surface retention-limited or quarantined state explicitly rather than masking it as absence. | Cached workspace posture is rebuildable from durable truth and must rebase rather than infer missed transitions. | MASKED_OR_LIMITED_ONLY | no | no | Algorithm/northbound_api_and_session_contract.md::L50[WorkspaceSnapshot] |
